question: What is the most appropriate description of Annamacharya’s contribution to devotional literature?

options.text: Wrote Sanskrit verses on social hierarchy
Composed thousands of devotional songs promoting equality
Limited his works only to temple rituals
Focused purely on musical structure without social themes

solution:
The correct answer is __**Composed thousands of devotional songs promoting equality**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Annamacharya**, also known as **Tallapaka Annamacharya**, was a 15th-century saint and poet from **Andhra Pradesh**. He is considered one of the earliest composers of Carnatic music.
 
• He is credited with composing over **32,000 songs**, primarily in the **Telugu language**, though some of his works are also in Sanskrit.
 
• Annamacharya's songs, known as **Keerthanas**, were dedicated to the deity **Lord Venkateswara** of Tirumala. His works emphasized **spirituality**, devotion, and equality among all individuals. *Hence, option 2 is correct.*
